class ResolveCommandExecutor:
    '''
        Command executor strategy for domain resolution.

        It defines:

            :attributes:
                | definition - The command CLI metadata definition.
                | _checker - Injected parameters checker.
                | _reporter - Injected reporter for messaging.
                | _verbose - Injected Enable/Disable verbose option.
            :methods:
                | execute - Executes the subcommand.
                | get_definition - Returns the command definition metadata.
                | __str__ - Returns the ResolveCommandExecutor as string representation.
    '''

    definition: ICommandDefinition
    _checker: IChecker
    _reporter: IReporter
    _verbose: bool

    def __init__(self, definition: ICommandDefinition, bundle: ContextBundle) -> None:
        '''
            Initializes ResolveCommandExecutor.

            :param definition: The command definition metadata.
            :param bundle: Context bundle to use for command execution.
            :exceptions:
                | ATSValueError: If the context bundle is not provided.
        '''
        if not bundle:
            raise ATSValueError('context bundle must be provided.')

        self.definition = definition
        self._checker = bundle.checker
        self._reporter = bundle.reporter
        self._verbose = bundle.verbose



[docs]
    def execute(self, *, params: Mapping[str, object], service: IService) -> Mapping[str, object]:
        '''
            Executes the subcommand.

            :param params: Subcommand parameters from CLI parser.
            :param service: Command orchestrator service instance.
            :return: Mapping containing the return code, stdout, and stderr.
        '''
        domain: str = str(params.get("domain", ""))
        verbose_str: str = str(params.get("verbose", "False"))
        verbose: bool = str(verbose_str).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes", "on")

        if verbose:
            self._reporter.success([f"\n    dns_explorer::pro::dns_processor Resolving single domain {domain}\n"])

        res: ResolvedDomain | None = service.check_dns(domain=domain, verbose=verbose)

        if res:
            self._reporter.success([f"\n    Resolved: {res.domain}"])
            self._reporter.success([f"    IP Address: {res.ip}"])
            self._reporter.success(["    Reverse DNS:"])

            for host in res.reverse:
                self._reporter.success([f"        - {host}"])

            self._reporter.success([""])

            return {"returncode": 0, "stdout": f"resolved {domain}", "stderr": ""}
        else:
            self._reporter.success([f"\nResolution failed for {domain}\n"])

            return {"returncode": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": f"resolution failed for {domain}"}

    def get_definition(self) -> ICommandDefinition:
        '''
            Returns the command definition metadata.

            :return: The command definition metadata.
        '''
        return self.definition



    def __str__(self) -> str:
        '''
            Returns the ResolveCommandExecutor as string representation.

            :return: The ResolveCommandExecutor as string representation.
        '''
        return to_str(self)
